messages.text: Hi there! Long story, sorry. My sister visited last week and we redecorated the living room, and the rattan lampshade just didn't go with the new colours at all, so I sent it back on Monday. The brass base stays, I love it. Oh, and do you know if the green velvet cushions will be back in stock soon? Anyway, can I get my money back for the shade?

messages.text:
Yes, the shop's records show the rattan lampshade as received back (refund-policy/v2/return). I've made a refund proposal for it.

- **Amount:** 30.00 BRL, which is what you paid for the shade (refund-policy/v2/amount).
- **Next step:** Please confirm it with the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count as confirmation. A staff member then has to approve it (refund-policy/v2/approval).

The brass base isn't part of this request, so it stays with you.

I can't tell you whether the green velvet cushions will be back in stock. The policy doesn't cover stock, and I don't have that information.
